title: Syntactically multilinear fan-in-two AND/OR circuits for an incidence without 4-cycles have at least |E|/4 gates (known kind, rebuilt)
formal_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ p p' l l' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → l ≠ l' → ¬ (I p l ∧ I p l' ∧ I p' l ∧ I p' l')) → PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.AndOrOnly C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C → PEqualNP.SyntacticMultilinear.IsSyntMultilinear (N + N) C → (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C z = true ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) → (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Fin N × Fin N => I e.1 e.2)).card ≤ 4 * C.size
plain_statement: N points and N lines with an incidence I, no two points on two common lines; inputs the points, then the lines. A circuit of AND and OR gates of fan-in at most two is syntactically multilinear when every AND gate reads two wires whose supports (the inputs each can reach) are disjoint. Every such circuit true exactly when some incident point and line are both on has at least |E|/4 gates, E the incident pairs. Conjecture.

known.citation: a few lines from, with a weaker constant than: Jukna, Lower bounds for tropical circuits and dynamic programs, 2014, Remark 10 with Theorems 9 and 18
